title: Microsoft SharePoint: Enhanced data access governance reports and site access reviews
summary: Microsoft SharePoint will enhance data access governance reports and site access reviews starting late November 2026, giving admins better control to identify data risks, prioritize sites, direct review requests, and track email delivery. No action is required before rollout, but admins should prepare accordingly.
body:
[What and why]

Microsoft SharePoint is enhancing data access governance reports and site access reviews to give SharePoint admins more control, flexibility, and transparency when identifying and addressing potential data exposure. These updates help admins prioritize sites that may present the greatest data risk, direct review requests to the appropriate recipients, and track whether notifications were delivered.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, and DoD): We will begin rolling out in late November 2026 and expect to complete by early December 2026

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- SharePoint admins who use data access governance reports and initiate site access reviewsPlatforms and services

- SharePoint Online- SharePoint admin center- Data access governance reports- Site access reviewsWhat will happen

- The Site permissions across your organization report will show the number of files flagged by sensitive information types, such as credit card numbers, Social Security numbers, and custom-defined patterns.- SharePoint admins will be able to use this information to prioritize sites that may present greater data risk.- Admins will be able to direct site access review requests to site owners or site admins.- Admins will be able to send either one consolidated review email to all recipients or separate emails to individual recipients.

- Admins will be able to view email delivery status and the complete recipient list for review requests.

[Action required and recommendations]

No action is required before rollout. We recommend that SharePoint admins:

- Review current site permissions and data access governance processes.- Inform relevant SharePoint admins about the enhanced reporting and site access review capabilities.- Update internal documentation and workflows as appropriate.- Confirm that site owners and site admins are prepared to receive and complete site access review requests.

Learn more

- Data access governance reports for SharePoint sites - SharePoint in Microsoft 365 | Microsoft Learn- Initiate site access reviews for Data access governance reports - SharePoint in Microsoft 365 | Microsoft Learn

[Compliance considerations]

ConsiderationExplanationDoes the change alter how existing customer data is accessed or processed?Yes. The Site permissions across your organization report will display counts of files flagged by sensitive information types. Does the change alter how admins can monitor, report on, or demonstrate compliance activities?Yes. SharePoint admins will receive additional reporting information about files flagged by sensitive information types and greater visibility into site access review recipients and email delivery status.Does the change include an admin control?Yes. SharePoint admins will be able to select review recipients and choose between consolidated and individual review emails.

ConsiderationExplanation
Does the change alter how existing customer data is accessed or processed?Yes. The Site permissions across your organization report will display counts of files flagged by sensitive information types.
